title: Fig. 5 Zero-g Integral Propulsion (ZIP) Unit for Gemini EVA
description: Black-and-white photograph of a handheld zero-g Integral Propulsion (ZIP) unit resting on a reflective surface, showing its tubular frame, oxygen nozzles, handle and a mounted camera. The accompanying text (NASA document M-913-65-04, 6/1/65) explains the device propels the astronaut by jetting oxygen through one forward and two aft firing nozzles and includes a camera for extravehicular photography. Captioned "FIG. 5"; the page also lists G4C suit qualification tests and notes on the 25-foot tether and emergency chestpack.
